description: Sync every task, subtask and task comment from the ClickUp Workspaces you choose, plus one overview page per Workspace. ClickUp permissions are not imported.
opening: Sync every task and subtask, including closed and archived ones, from the ClickUp Workspaces you select. Each task is one document with its description, status, people, checklists, custom fields, and its list, folder and space names. Each comment is its own document, linked to its task. Each Workspace is one short overview page listing its members.

ClickUp permissions are not imported, so every synced item is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Task dependencies and linked tasks do not become links. Items deleted in ClickUp can stay in HydraDB.

notes: ClickUp guest access and private Spaces, Lists and Tasks are not reproduced. Set an access rule on each Workspace that should be restricted.
Every synced item carries a fixed note saying ClickUp visibility is not captured, in `additional_metadata.rbac_warning`. The note itself restricts nothing.

connect.auth: ClickUp uses a personal API token. It has no scopes to choose: it sees what its user sees.

credentials.name: api_token
credentials.text: A ClickUp personal API token, which starts with `pk_`.

connect.credentials_note: ClickUp limits requests per token by Workspace plan, starting at 100 a minute on Free, Unlimited and Business. To rotate the token, generate a new one, update the connector, check that HydraDB still lists your Workspaces and a sync succeeds, then revoke the old one.

steps.title: Create a token
steps.text: In ClickUp, open your avatar, Settings, Apps, API Token, and generate a token. Use a dedicated account that can open every Workspace you plan to select.

steps.title: Select Workspaces
steps.text: HydraDB lists every Workspace the token can see. Select the Workspaces to sync. Each selected Workspace syncs its tasks and subtasks, whether open, closed or archived.

connect.account: One connector reads what one token's ClickUp user can see.

sync.first_sync: A newly selected Workspace reads back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default, measured on when tasks were last updated. The comments on those tasks are read in full, however old they are. Workspace overviews are read in full.
sync.changes: Each sync reads the tasks updated since the last sync, whether open, closed or archived, and reads all comments on each of those tasks again.
sync.edits: An edited task is picked up through its last-updated time and updates its document. A comment is read again only when its task is picked up.
sync.deletes: Tasks and comments deleted in ClickUp can stay searchable in HydraDB.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's items. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.rbac_warning
shared_attributes.text: A fixed note that ClickUp visibility is not captured and the item is open to everyone who can query the collection. It does not restrict access. Not searchable.

documents.name: Tasks
documents.one_document: One ClickUp task or subtask. Its comments are separate documents.
documents.title: The task name, or `ClickUp task` and its id when the name is empty.
documents.text: The task name, then the description as plain text when it differs from the name. Then `Status`, `Assignees`, `Priority`, `Tags`, `List`, `Folder` and `Space` lines, each checklist with its items marked `[ ]` or `[x]`, each custom field with a value as `name: value`, and one `Attachment` line per file name. The creator, the first assignee, the creation and closure dates, the task id and the parent are written into the task details too. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the task was last updated, or when it was created if there is no update time.
documents.files: Files attached to the task are downloaded with the connector's token and read, and their text becomes searchable with the task. A file with no id or download address is skipped. A file that fails to download or is not a supported type keeps only its details.

attributes.name: Task id
attributes.text: The ClickUp task id. It keeps later syncs on the same document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.text: The status label, written as the `Status` line.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.text: The priority label, written as the `Priority` line.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.text: Tag names, written as the `Tags` line.

attributes.name: assignees
attributes.text: Every assignee's username, or email, written as the `Assignees` line.

attributes.name: assignee
attributes.text: The first assignee's username, or email. The graph records that person as the assignee. Other assignees are only in the text.

attributes.name: assignee_email
attributes.text: The first assignee's email, when available. Identifies the assignee in the graph. Not searchable.

attributes.name: reporter
attributes.text: The creator's display name, or email. The graph records that person as the reporter.

attributes.name: reporter_email
attributes.text: The creator's email, when available. Identifies the reporter in the graph. Not searchable.

attributes.name: list_name, folder_name, space_name
attributes.text: The names of the task's list, folder and space, written as `List`, `Folder` and `Space` lines. They are not filters, and they do not become items in the graph.

attributes.name: checklists
attributes.text: Each checklist name and its items, marked done or not done.

attributes.name: clickup_custom_fields
attributes.text: Each custom field that has a value, written as `name: value`.

attributes.name: Attached files
attributes.text: The text read from each attached file, searchable with the task. Each file name is also written as an `Attachment` line.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the task was created, written into the task details. Sets the result date only when there is no update time.

attributes.name: resolved_at
attributes.text: When the task was closed, written into the task details.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the task was last updated. Sets the result date and decides when a sync picks the task up. Not searchable.

attributes.name: date_created, date_updated, date_closed
attributes.text: The original times in milliseconds, as ClickUp sends them. They become `created_at`, `updated_at` and `resolved_at`. Not searchable.

attributes.name: parent_id
attributes.text: For a subtask, its parent task's id. Links the subtask to its parent.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.clickup_task_id
attributes.text: The ClickUp task id. Picks out one task. Not searchable.

attributes.name: creator, creator_id
attributes.text: The creator's username, or email, and ClickUp id, as ClickUp sends them. The same person is searchable through `reporter`.

attributes.name: assignee_ids
attributes.text: The ClickUp ids of all assignees.

attributes.name: parent
attributes.text: The parent task id as ClickUp sends it. `parent_id` carries the searchable parent and the link.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.text: The due date. It is not written into the text.

attributes.name: clickup_due_date
attributes.text: The due date in milliseconds, as ClickUp sends it.

attributes.name: dependencies, linked_tasks
attributes.text: Dependency and linked-task references. They are not written into the text and do not become links.

attributes.name: team_id
attributes.text: The Workspace id.

attributes.name: list_id, folder_id, space_id
attributes.text: The ids of the task's list, folder and space.

documents.name: Comments
documents.title: `Comment by <author> on <task name>`, or `Comment on <task name>` without an author.
documents.text: A `Task` line with the task name and id, then the comment text. The author, the comment time and the task id are written with it.
documents.link_back: The task's page in ClickUp. Comments have no link of their own.

attributes.name: author
attributes.text: The commenter's username, or email. The graph records the comment as written by that person.

attributes.name: author_email
attributes.text: The commenter's email, when ClickUp returns it. Identifies the commenter in the graph. Not searchable.

attributes.name: task_name
attributes.text: The name of the task, in the `Task` line, so a comment matches queries about its task.

attributes.name: parent_id
attributes.text: The id of the task the comment is on. Links the comment to that task.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the comment was posted, written as the `Created` line.

attributes.name: date
attributes.text: The comment time in milliseconds, as ClickUp sends it. It becomes `created_at`. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.clickup_comment_id
attributes.text: The ClickUp comment id. Picks out one comment. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.clickup_task_id
attributes.text: The id of the task. Returns every comment on one task. Not searchable.

attributes.name: author_id
attributes.text: The commenter's ClickUp id.

attributes.name: resolved
attributes.text: Whether the action assigned in the comment is resolved.

attributes.name: team_id
attributes.text: The Workspace id.

documents.name: Workspace overviews
documents.title: The Workspace name, or `ClickUp workspace` and its id when the name is empty.
documents.text: `ClickUp workspace:` and the name, then a `Members` line with member usernames or emails. The title is searchable too.

attributes.name: member_names
attributes.text: Member display names, written as the `Members` line. Members are not added to the graph as people.

attributes.name: members
attributes.text: The member details ClickUp returned.

attributes.name: color
attributes.text: The Workspace color.

attributes.name: avatar
attributes.text: The link to the Workspace avatar image.

example_searches: What is open and high priority in the Mobile list?
Which checklist items are still open on the launch task?
What did people say in the comments on the checkout redesign task?

connections: A subtask to its parent task.
Task dependencies and linked tasks do not become links.
No links to items in other tools.
people: The creator and the first assignee of each task.
Other assignees and Workspace members appear only in the text.
graph.from_text: Task descriptions, checklist items, custom field values and comment text.

not_synced: Spaces, folders and lists as items of their own. Their names appear on tasks.
Goals, time entries, tags as items of their own, custom field definitions and task templates.
ClickUp visibility: guests, and private Spaces, Lists and Tasks.
Attached files with no usable id or download address.
